111:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, let's get to work again today... Business, business! Though I don't sell charms from blondes...」

111:t_10:36.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What is this charm you're talking about?!」

112:t_000:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「$$ピーターソン基地$$ is in sight!」

112:t_000:1.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「As expected, it looks like they haven't set up a defensive line yet.」

112:t_000:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Don't let your guard down. Something is sure to happen in this battle...」

112:t_000:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(The $$νガンダム$$ and $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s invasion... And $$ピーターソン基地$$ fell far too easily... If my prediction is right...)

112:t_001:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's that $$ヤクト・ドーガ$$...! Is that you, $$ギュネイ$$?!」

112:t_001:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ギュネイ$$! Why did $$ネオ・ジオン$$ come down to Earth?!」

112:t_001:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, begin attacking! With only this much resistance, we can retake the base ourselves!」

112:t_001:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
($$ギュネイ$$ is confused and angry... There really is something going on...)

112:t_002:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain...! A force is approaching us!」

112:t_002:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「Are they $$ネオ・ジオン$$ reinforcements?!」

112:t_004:1.en:
$$レイアム$$
「The $$ＧＮ－ＸⅣ$$ units are attacking us! We believe they were targeting this ship from the start, rather than firing by mistake!」

112:t_004:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「Were those units captured by the enemy...?!」

112:t_004:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Are you saying part of the $$地球連邦軍$$ has sided with $$ネオ・ジオン$$...?!」

112:t_004:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「No...! $$ネオ・ジオン$$ isn't who they've joined forces with!」

112:t_004:7.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「I've confirmed more units approaching!」

112:t_005:1.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「All units, spread out! From now on, we'll conduct operations jointly with $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and the $$新地球皇国$$!」

112:t_005:3.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Tch...! So not only $$ネオ・ジオン$$, but part of the Federation has joined those $$サイデリアル$$ bastards too!」

112:t_005:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ギュネイ$$! Has $$ネオ・ジオン$$ really joined forces with $$サイデリアル$$?!」

112:t_005:11.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「You lowly Earthling, you dare get above yourself...」

112:t_005:12.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'm the commander of this operation! Follow my orders!」

112:t_005:14.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Tch... What are you planning to do...?」

112:t_006:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What are you trying to do, $$ギュネイ$$?」

112:t_006:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Get in the $$ガンダム$$, $$アムロ・レイ$$.」

112:t_006:3.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I've already transmitted its location. Hurry.」

112:t_006:5.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「There's no point in winning a fight against a pathetic mobile suit! Hurry up!」

112:t_006:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...All right. I'll go along with your plan.」

112:t_007:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Follow me, $$アムロ・レイ$$.」

112:t_008:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Stay out of this, $$カミーユ$$. This is something I need to settle for myself.」

112:t_008:3.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$アムロ・レイ$$... In the end, the Colonel chose to fight beside you instead of $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s $$赤い彗星$$.」

112:t_008:4.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「That's why I'll defeat you...! And I'll surpass the Colonel!」

112:t_008:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I have no intention of being anyone's stepping stone...! I still have things I need to do!」

112:t_008:6.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「All units, begin attacking! I'll take on $$アムロ・レイ$$!」

112:t_008:7.en:
$$オットー$$
「Return fire! $$ネオ・ジオン$$, the $$連邦軍$$, and $$サイデリアル$$ are all enemies!」

112:t_008:8.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$! I'll leave $$ギュネイ$$ to you!」

112:t_008:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
(Come on, $$ギュネイ$$. I'll face you in $$シャア$$'s place...!)

112:t_009:0.en:
$$オットー$$
「We managed to pull through...」

112:t_009:1.en:
$$レイアム$$
「We wouldn't have won if the enemy commander, $$ギュネイ・ガス$$, hadn't let his pride cloud his judgment.」

112:t_009:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「Pride... ...So he was still human after all...」

112:t_009:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
(Without $$シャア$$, where is $$ネオ・ジオン$$ headed...?)

112:t_010:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Stop, $$ギュネイ$$! Do you think $$ネオ・ジオン$$ has a future after joining forces with $$サイデリアル$$?!」

112:t_010:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Shut up, $$カミーユ$$! I don't need you to tell me that!」

112:t_010:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then come with us! You've fought alongside us before, so you should know what you need to do!」

112:t_010:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'm sure Colonel $$シャア$$ wants that too!」

112:t_010:4.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'll surpass that man...! And with that power, the $$スペースノイド$$...!」

112:t_010:6.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Get out of my way, $$カミーユ$$! The man I'm fighting now is $$アムロ・レイ$$!」

112:t_011:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Damn it...! Is this as far as I can go?!」

112:t_011:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Wait, $$ギュネイ$$! I want to talk to you!」

112:t_011:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I have nothing to say to you! I am... $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」
